items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong Battery Energy Storage - BESS - demand has tipped the market balance into a favorable territory.

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: ALB's earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for Q4 since its Q2 release. Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell).

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered the price target on Albemarle to $135 from $230 and keeps a Buy rating.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered its price target on Albemarle to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform, following recent spot price weakness.
